method: Built-in image_gen; independent grain atlases, subsequently assembled and de-lit by build_material.py.
common: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: flat diffuse albedo source atlas for a realistic survival-game floor material. Square image filled edge to edge by exactly SIX equal-width horizontal sawn softwood planks, grain running perfectly horizontally. Orthographic straight overhead, zero perspective, completely flat cross-polarized diffuse colour, no illumination shading, no directional lighting, no highlights, no vignette, no shadows. Each plank is 25 cm across and about 150 cm long, cut off cleanly by left and right image boundaries. Extremely narrow straight seams between the six strips. No nails, no screws, no hardware, no vertical butt joints, no text, no border. Years of walking and rain: faded warm grey-brown weathered pine, subtle silver fibers over a warm brown undertone, dense slender irregular latewood grain lines, tiny longitudinal checks, gently scuffed smoother areas. Real small scale grain and worn wood fibers resolved sharply. Not deeply splintered, not driftwood, not barn siding, not painted, not varnished. Each strip is an individual board from the same wood species with distinct grain, gentle differences in grey/brown tone. Minimal small subdued knots; no huge dark knots, no eye-catching marks. Fine surface texture, authentic irregular natural grain, balanced restrained contrast. Seamless left-to-right texture where feasible.
variants: Atlas A: mostly straight and gently wavering grain, warm medium grey-brown, 2 boards with subtle broad cathedral grain; one tiny faded pin knot total. Warm muted brown, average RGB around 145,123,100.

Atlas B: slightly cooler silvered grey-brown, denser tight latewood grain with occasional low-contrast curved growth figures, subtle irregular scuffing; no conspicuous knots. Average RGB around 151,133,113.

Atlas C: old honey-grey pine, muted warmer undertone beneath faded silvery surface, fine very irregular grain of varying widths, a little darker wash in tiny checks, one small faint knot. Average RGB around 143,121,98.

Atlas D: pale worn drift-grey surface with restrained warm brown grain, quiet patchy foot-polishing and faint water discoloration, small fine linear checks, a mix of rift and flat sawn grain, two tiny pale knots. Average RGB around 151,134,114.
